alt: Person holding the TECNO Borderless Concept phone, its 6.7-inch display appearing to run fully edge-to-edge with no visible border around the screen
story: TECNO's concept phone, unveiled at IFA 2026 on September 3, 2026, claims 'literally zero display border — not 1mm, not 0.5mm, zero' by raising the metal frame slightly above the screen surface, but hands-on testing found users' fingers catch on the raised lip with every edge swipe gesture — the exact problem bezels were designed to prevent.
why_funny: They eliminated the visible bezel and replaced it with an invisible physical lip that catches your thumb even more — and the official fix is adding a screen protector, which is just a bezel with extra steps.
